title: Failed-Request Navigator — compact triage ribbon and retry guidance
creator: Ravi Kapoor
description:
Problem: Operators and SREs using Redwood Console need a faster way to triage failed inference requests across noisy workloads. Current failure views surface entire traces but require too many context switches to decide whether to retry, escalate, or ignore.

Goal: Design a compact "ribbon" UI that surfaces a prioritized set of triage signals for each failed request (error taxonomy, retryability, likely root cause hints, correlated events, and quick payload diff) while preserving a path to the full request detail page. The ribbon must be scannable in list view, support inline lightweight actions (retry, mark as ignored, attach note), and show confidence for automated suggestions.

Scope:
- Compact ribbon component for failed request rows in the Failed Requests dashboard and the Request Search results.
- Inline payload preview with token-preserving truncation and a one-click open-to-diff experience.
- Heuristic retry guidance: why a retry is recommended (transient network, rate-limit, downstream timeout) and an estimated success confidence.
- Error taxonomy tags mapped to backend error codes (transient, deterministic, model-error, infra).
- Keyboard affordances and mobile-responsive behavior for small consoles.

Out of scope for this ticket: backend classification model changes (ENG work tracked separately), deep replay/step-through flow — only a CTA to the existing replay studio.
acceptance_criteria: Ribbon appears inline in failed request list rows and Request Search results
Ribbon shows primary error tag, retryability indicator, confidence score, and time-to-failure metric
Inline payload preview preserves first N tokens and highlights keys that changed vs. last successful request when available
Retry action triggers existing retry workflow and surfaces a lightweight confirmation modal with suggested backoff and expected success confidence
Design has annotated responsive states for narrow consoles and accessible ARIA labels for all controls
Prototype reviewed and signed off by PM and ENG with a follow-up list for telemetry events required
comments: 2026-02-21 — Ravi: Kickoff meeting with PM (Lina Chen) and Eng leads (Marco Rossi). Agreed ribbon needs to be non-blocking and prioritizes minimal server calls. Captured initial signal list: error_code -> taxonomy mapping, last_success_delta, retryability_hint, correlated_error_count, and quick-payload-hash for diff retrieval.

2026-02-26 — Ava: First sketch iteration attached. Compact mode uses three chip areas: (1) error taxonomy + color, (2) retryability + confidence meter, (3) actions (retry/note/expand). We discussed replacing numerical confidence with 3 states (Low/Medium/High) per accessibility guidance.

2026-03-01 — PM review (Lina): Requested stronger visual separation between automated suggestions and user actions. Also asked for 'why' text under hover to explain taxonomy mapping to non-engineers. Lina requested an optional 'mute' for recurring known failures per customer-level filters.

2026-03-04 — ENG feedback (Marco): Backend will add a compact payload-diff endpoint (ENG-6120) but response is throttled. We need to memoize diff previews and fall back to 'open full details' if diff not available. Also raised latency budget: ribbon render must not add more than 50ms p99 to list load; design to support optimistic placeholders.

2026-03-07 — Accessibility review (Priya Gupta): Recommend replace color-only taxonomy marker with icon + text, ensure actions are reachable by keyboard, add visible focus states, and ensure confidence meter has text fallback for screen readers.

2026-03-10 — Usability test (3 sessions): Observations — engineers scan taxonomy + confidence first, then open payload diff when confidence is medium/high. Some testers expect retry to surface last 3 attempts and rate-limit cooldown; added to follow-up asks. Average first-decision time reduced from 18s to 7s with ribbon in prototype.

2026-03-11 — Design review notes: Consolidate iconography, tighten spacing to fit 6 ribbon chips in 1160px width, and produce Figma component variants for 'dense', 'default', and 'expanded' states. PRD links and telemetry event names requested.

2026-03-12 — Ava: Submitted prototype link and annotated handoff (see attachments). Leaving a TODO to sync with ENG on telemetry event names (telemetry mapping doc) and to add security review for payload preview access controls. Marking ticket In Review.
2026-03-12 — Ravi: Added dependency on ENG-6120 (compact payload-diff service) and ENG-6319 (retry-suggestion model). Also cross-referenced console release planning: console-2026.04 rollout window.
